cues: A collocation is a pair of words that travel together, and the verb is not free.
You make a decision, a mistake, progress, friends.
You do homework, a favour, research, your best.
You take an examination, a photograph, a risk.
You have breakfast and an argument; you give a speech and advice; you pay attention and a visit.
text: A collocation is a pair of words that travel together, and the verb is not free. You make a decision, a mistake, progress, friends. You do homework, a favour, research, your best.
